requirements.text: The app should provide real-time transaction alerts, including the amount spent, merchant details, and remaining balance.
Monthly spending summaries should categorize expenses to help users understand where their money is going.
Users must be able to instantly freeze and unfreeze their cards within the app for added security.
The app should feature a clean, modern layout that is easy to navigate and responsive, similar to fintech apps like Revolut.
The overall user experience must prioritize straightforward access to features without getting lost in complex menus.
